```{r}
set.seed(123)

# large Monte Carlo sample
n <- 1000000

# start with one Beta scenario
beta <- 0.5
gamma <- 0.5

# simulate true propensity scores
e <- rbeta(n, shape1 = beta, shape2 = gamma)

# variance contribution under homoskedasticity
v_contrib <- 1/e + 1/(1 - e)


epsilons <- c(0.005, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05)

# function for hard trimming
hard_var <- function(e, alpha) {

  keep <- e >= alpha & e <= 1 - alpha

  v <- 1/e + 1/(1 - e)

  mean(v[keep]) / mean(keep)
}

smooth_var <- function(e) {

  w <- e * (1 - e)

  v <- 1/e + 1/(1 - e)

  mean(w^2 * v) / mean(w)^2
}


ess_ratio <- function(w) {
  (sum(w)^2 / sum(w^2)) / length(w)
}



tv_distance <- function(e, w, breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)) {

  # Put propensity scores into bins
  bins <- cut(
    e,
    breaks = breaks,
    include.lowest = TRUE
  )

  # Original proportion of observations in each bin
  p_original <- as.numeric(table(bins)) / length(e)

  # Total weight in each bin
  weighted_counts <- tapply(w, bins, sum)

  # In case any bin is empty
  weighted_counts[is.na(weighted_counts)] <- 0

  # Convert weighted counts into proportions
  p_weighted <- weighted_counts / sum(weighted_counts)

  # Total variation distance
  TVD <- 0.5 * sum(abs(p_original - p_weighted))

  return(TVD)
}

smoothstep <- function(x) {
  
  ifelse(
    x <= 0, 0,
    ifelse(
      x >= 1, 1,
      3*x^2 - 2*x^3
    )
  )
}


boundary_smooth_weights <- function(e, delta,
                                    alpha1 = 0.10,
                                    alpha2 = 0.90) {
  
  # Smooth transition from 0 to 1 around the lower cutoff
  left <- smoothstep(
    (e - (alpha1 - delta)) / (2 * delta)
  )
  
  # Smooth transition from 1 to 0 around the upper cutoff
  right <- smoothstep(
    ((alpha2 + delta) - e) / (2 * delta)
  )
  
  w <- left * right
  
  return(w)
}

weighted_var <- function(e, w) {

  v <- 1/e + 1/(1 - e)

  mean(w^2 * v) / mean(w)^2
}

```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# Large Monte Carlo sample
n <- 1000000

# Start with one of the Beta distributions from the paper
beta <- 0.5
gamma <- 0.5

# Simulate propensity scores
e <- rbeta(n, shape1 = beta, shape2 = gamma)

# Variance contribution with no trimming
v <- 1/e + 1/(1 - e)

# No trimming
V_none <- mean(v)

# Hard trimming at 0.01
V_001 <- hard_var(e, 0.01)

# Hard trimming at 0.10
V_010 <- hard_var(e, 0.10)

# Search over possible alpha values to find the optimal hard cutoff
alphas <- seq(0.001, 0.49, by = 0.001)

V_alpha <- sapply(alphas, function(a) {
  hard_var(e, a)
})

# Optimal alpha
alpha_star <- alphas[which.min(V_alpha)]

# Corresponding minimum variance
V_star <- min(V_alpha)

# Print the results
V_none
V_001
V_010
alpha_star
V_star
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

n <- 1000000

# All Beta parameter combinations used in the paper
param_grid <- data.frame(
  beta  = c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5,
            1.0, 1.0, 1.0,
            2.0, 2.0,
            4.0),
  gamma = c(0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0,
            1.0, 2.0, 4.0,
            2.0, 4.0,
            4.0)
)

run_one_beta <- function(beta, gamma, n = 1000000) {

  # simulate propensity scores

  e <- rbeta(n, shape1 = beta, shape2 = gamma)


  # har trimming variance calculations

  # variance contribution with no trimming
  v <- 1/e + 1/(1 - e)

  # no trimming
  V_none <- mean(v)

  # fixed trimming rules
  V_001 <- hard_var(e, 0.01)
  V_010 <- hard_var(e, 0.10)

  # search for optimal hard cutoff
  alphas <- seq(0.001, 0.49, by = 0.001)

  V_alpha <- sapply(alphas, function(a) {
    hard_var(e, a)
  })

  alpha_star <- alphas[which.min(V_alpha)]
  V_star <- min(V_alpha)


  # weighting rule definitions

  # optimal hard trimming
  w_hard_opt <- as.numeric(
    e >= alpha_star & e <= 1 - alpha_star
  )

  # fixed 0.10 hard trimming
  w_hard_010 <- as.numeric(
    e >= 0.10 & e <= 0.90
  )

  # full smooth overlap weighting
  w_smooth <- e * (1 - e)

  # smooth-boundary weights
  w_delta_005 <- boundary_smooth_weights(
    e,
    delta = 0.005
  )

  w_delta_010 <- boundary_smooth_weights(
    e,
    delta = 0.01
  )

  w_delta_025 <- boundary_smooth_weights(
    e,
    delta = 0.025
  )

  w_delta_050 <- boundary_smooth_weights(
    e,
    delta = 0.05
  )


  # variance calculations for boundary smoothing

  V_smooth <- smooth_var(e)

  V_delta_005 <- weighted_var(e, w_delta_005)
  V_delta_010 <- weighted_var(e, w_delta_010)
  V_delta_025 <- weighted_var(e, w_delta_025)
  V_delta_050 <- weighted_var(e, w_delta_050)

  # variance ratios relative to optimal hard trim
  ratio_delta_005 <- V_delta_005 / V_star
  ratio_delta_010 <- V_delta_010 / V_star
  ratio_delta_025 <- V_delta_025 / V_star
  ratio_delta_050 <- V_delta_050 / V_star


  # ess ratios

  ESS_opt <- ess_ratio(w_hard_opt)
  ESS_010 <- ess_ratio(w_hard_010)
  ESS_smooth <- ess_ratio(w_smooth)

  ESS_delta_005 <- ess_ratio(w_delta_005)
  ESS_delta_010 <- ess_ratio(w_delta_010)
  ESS_delta_025 <- ess_ratio(w_delta_025)
  ESS_delta_050 <- ess_ratio(w_delta_050)


  # tvd

  TVD_opt <- tv_distance(e, w_hard_opt)
  TVD_010 <- tv_distance(e, w_hard_010)
  TVD_smooth <- tv_distance(e, w_smooth)

  TVD_delta_005 <- tv_distance(e, w_delta_005)
  TVD_delta_010 <- tv_distance(e, w_delta_010)
  TVD_delta_025 <- tv_distance(e, w_delta_025)
  TVD_delta_050 <- tv_distance(e, w_delta_050)


  # tvd sensitivity check

  # bin width = 0.025
  TVD_010_bw025 <- tv_distance(
    e,
    w_hard_010,
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.025)
  )

  TVD_smooth_bw025 <- tv_distance(
    e,
    w_smooth,
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.025)
  )

  # bin width = 0.05
  TVD_010_bw050 <- tv_distance(
    e,
    w_hard_010,
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)
  )

  TVD_smooth_bw050 <- tv_distance(
    e,
    w_smooth,
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)
  )

  # bin width = 0.10
  TVD_010_bw100 <- tv_distance(
    e,
    w_hard_010,
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.10)
  )

  TVD_smooth_bw100 <- tv_distance(
    e,
    w_smooth,
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.10)
  )


  # return results in dataframe

  data.frame(
    beta = beta,
    gamma = gamma,
    alpha_star = alpha_star,

    V_none = V_none,
    V_001 = V_001,
    V_010 = V_010,
    V_star = V_star,
    V_smooth = V_smooth,

    ratio_none = V_none / V_star,
    ratio_001 = V_001 / V_star,
    ratio_010 = V_010 / V_star,
    ratio_smooth = V_smooth / V_star,

    ESS_opt = ESS_opt,
    ESS_010 = ESS_010,
    ESS_smooth = ESS_smooth,

    TVD_opt = TVD_opt,
    TVD_010 = TVD_010,
    TVD_smooth = TVD_smooth,

    ratio_delta_005 = ratio_delta_005,
    ratio_delta_010 = ratio_delta_010,
    ratio_delta_025 = ratio_delta_025,
    ratio_delta_050 = ratio_delta_050,

    ESS_delta_005 = ESS_delta_005,
    ESS_delta_010 = ESS_delta_010,
    ESS_delta_025 = ESS_delta_025,
    ESS_delta_050 = ESS_delta_050,

    TVD_delta_005 = TVD_delta_005,
    TVD_delta_010 = TVD_delta_010,
    TVD_delta_025 = TVD_delta_025,
    TVD_delta_050 = TVD_delta_050,

    TVD_010_bw025 = TVD_010_bw025,
    TVD_smooth_bw025 = TVD_smooth_bw025,

    TVD_010_bw050 = TVD_010_bw050,
    TVD_smooth_bw050 = TVD_smooth_bw050,

    TVD_010_bw100 = TVD_010_bw100,
    TVD_smooth_bw100 = TVD_smooth_bw100
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Smoothstep function for boundary smoothing
smoothstep <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    x <= 0, 0,
    ifelse(
      x >= 1, 1,
      3*x^2 - 2*x^3
    )
  )
}

# Boundary-smoothed trimming weight
boundary_smooth_weights <- function(e, delta = 0.05,
                                    alpha1 = 0.10,
                                    alpha2 = 0.90) {
  
  left <- smoothstep(
    (e - (alpha1 - delta)) / (2 * delta)
  )
  
  right <- smoothstep(
    ((alpha2 + delta) - e) / (2 * delta)
  )
  
  left * right
}

# Grid of propensity scores
e_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 1000)

# Build plot data
plot_df <- data.frame(
  e = e_grid,
  hard_trim = ifelse(e_grid >= 0.10 & e_grid <= 0.90, 1, 0),
  boundary_smooth = boundary_smooth_weights(e_grid, delta = 0.05),
  overlap_weight = 4 * e_grid * (1 - e_grid)   # scaled to max = 1
)

# Long format
plot_df_long <- plot_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(hard_trim, boundary_smooth, overlap_weight),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "weight"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = recode(
      method,
      hard_trim = "Hard trim",
      boundary_smooth = "Boundary smooth",
      overlap_weight = "Smooth weight: 4e(1-e)"
    )
  )

# Plot
ggplot(plot_df_long, aes(x = e, y = weight, linetype = method)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  labs(
    x = "Propensity score e",
    y = "Weight",
    linetype = NULL,
    title = "Comparison of weighting rules"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.05)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```




```{r}
library(dplyr)

slide_table <- results %>%
  filter(
    (beta == 0.5 & gamma == 4) |
    (beta == 1   & gamma == 1) |
    (beta == 4   & gamma == 4)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Scenario = case_when(
      beta == 0.5 & gamma == 4 ~ "Beta(0.5, 4) - Poor overlap",
      beta == 1   & gamma == 1 ~ "Beta(1, 1) - Moderate overlap",
      beta == 4   & gamma == 4 ~ "Beta(4, 4) - Strong overlap"
    )
  )

slide_table_final <- bind_rows(
  
  slide_table %>%
    transmute(
      Scenario,
      Method = "Hard 0.10 trim",
      `Relative Efficiency Bound` = round(ratio_010, 2),
      `ESS/N` = round(ESS_010, 2),
      TVD = round(TVD_010, 2)
    ),
  
  slide_table %>%
    transmute(
      Scenario,
      Method = "Boundary smooth (delta = 0.05)",
      `Relative Efficiency Bound` = round(ratio_delta_050, 2),
      `ESS/N` = round(ESS_delta_050, 2),
      TVD = round(TVD_delta_050, 2)
    ),
  
  slide_table %>%
    transmute(
      Scenario,
      Method = "Smooth weight e(1-e)",
      `Relative Efficiency Bound` = round(ratio_smooth, 2),
      `ESS/N` = round(ESS_smooth, 2),
      TVD = round(TVD_smooth, 2)
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Scenario = factor(
      Scenario,
      levels = c(
        "Beta(0.5, 4) - Poor overlap",
        "Beta(1, 1) - Moderate overlap",
        "Beta(4, 4) - Strong overlap"
      )
    ),
    Method = factor(
      Method,
      levels = c(
        "Hard 0.10 trim",
        "Boundary smooth (delta = 0.05)",
        "Smooth weight e(1-e)"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Scenario, Method)

View(slide_table_final)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

eff_plot_df <- results %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = paste0("Beta(", beta, ", ", gamma, ")")
  ) %>%
  select(
    scenario,
    ratio_010,
    ratio_delta_050,
    ratio_smooth
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ratio_010, ratio_delta_050, ratio_smooth),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "relative_bound"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = recode(
      method,
      ratio_010 = "Hard 0.10 trim",
      ratio_delta_050 = "Boundary smooth (δ = 0.05)",
      ratio_smooth = "Smooth weight e(1-e)"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  eff_plot_df,
  aes(
    x = scenario,
    y = relative_bound,
    shape = method,
    group = method
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Propensity-score distribution",
    y = "Relative efficiency bound",
    shape = NULL,
    title = "Efficiency Bound Across Propensity-Score Distributions",
    subtitle = "Relative to the scenario-specific optimal hard trim"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

delta_plot_df <- results %>%
  mutate(
    Scenario = paste0("Beta(", beta, ", ", gamma, ")")
  ) %>%
  select(
    Scenario,
    ratio_delta_005,
    ratio_delta_010,
    ratio_delta_025,
    ratio_delta_050
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("ratio_delta_"),
    names_to = "delta",
    values_to = "relative_bound"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta = recode(
      delta,
      ratio_delta_005 = 0.005,
      ratio_delta_010 = 0.010,
      ratio_delta_025 = 0.025,
      ratio_delta_050 = 0.050
    )
  )

delta_plot_small <- delta_plot_df %>%
  filter(
    Scenario %in% c(
      "Beta(0.5, 4)",
      "Beta(1, 1)",
      "Beta(4, 4)"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  delta_plot_small,
  aes(
    x = delta,
    y = relative_bound,
    group = Scenario,
    color = Scenario
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = expression(delta),
    y = "Relative efficiency bound",
    color = "Overlap setting",
    title = "Boundary-Smoothing Sensitivity",
    subtitle = "Poor, moderate, and strong overlap scenarios"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
      ratio_delta_005,
      ratio_delta_010,
      ratio_delta_025,
      ratio_delta_050,
      ratio_smooth
    ),
    names_to = "Method",
    values_to = "Relative_Bound"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(
      Method,
      ratio_010       = "Hard trim 0.10",
      ratio_delta_005 = "Boundary δ = 0.005",
      ratio_delta_010 = "Boundary δ = 0.010",
      ratio_delta_025 = "Boundary δ = 0.025",
      ratio_delta_050 = "Boundary δ = 0.050",
      ratio_smooth    = "Smooth e(1-e)"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  boundary_compare_df,
  aes(
    x = Scenario,
    y = Relative_Bound,
    color = Method,
    group = Method
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Propensity-score distribution",
    y = "Relative efficiency bound",
    color = "Weighting method",
    title = "Boundary-Smoothing Sensitivity Across Beta Scenarios",
    subtitle = "Efficiency bound relative to the scenario-specific optimal hard trim"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
